why: The decode's first half, combinational: the check bits recomputed XOR those stored. At K = 128, 15.4 NGD: after an SRAM's rdata (which launches at 16.3) it cannot share the read's stage, so a parent flops rdata, then the syndrome (or uses the data speculatively and replays on a nonzero flopped syndrome). Timed in its parent.
